```sql
-- Find the geometry of Jhansi county
WITH jhansi AS (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
    WHERE id = '85c5e1c5-d461-4b9c-b6c3-c669bd444f12'
),

-- Find all regions that touch Jhansi
bordering_regions AS (
    SELECT d.id,
           d.names."primary" AS name,
           d.geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') d
    JOIN jhansi j
      ON ST_Touches(d.geometry, j.geometry)
    WHERE d.subtype = 'region'
)

SELECT id,
       name,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geometry
FROM bordering_regions;
```
